snippet.title: Ghost School FULL Game Walkthrough / Playthrough - Let's Play (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Ghost School By Kurousagi True Ending Horror Adventure Game Part 1 to Ending [Microsoft Windows]

Senna Akizuki wakes up to find herself in a dimly lit school. She is determined to find a way out with her friends. While exploring inside the school, Senna must uncover the school's gruesome past in order to escape.
